d: A two-headed humanoid creature of mature age with a massive, heavyset build and pale, greyish-blue skin. The heads are bald with glowing lime-green eyes and stoic expressions. The outfit consists of heavy, dark grey metal plating on the shoulders and lower legs, accented with lime-green glowing gems and spikes, worn over tattered dark purple and black fabric with a wide brown leather belt featuring a skull buckle. BODY COLOR: Greyish-blue LEGS: Plantigrade with heavy metal armored boots.
